CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
  )::text
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_assert_effective_permission(p_business uuid, p_permission text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.tenh_user_permission_allowed(p_business,auth.uid(),p_permission) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'This action is not allowed for your role.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_branch_limit(p_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
select case when subscription_status='active' and subscription_plan_key='custom' then subscription_branch_limit else 1 end from businesses where id=p_business_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_branch_setting_visible(p_business uuid, p_location uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from public.business_members where business_id=p_business and user_id=auth.uid() and is_active and not coalesce(team_password_required,false)) then return false;end if;
 return p_location=public.tenh_request_branch(p_business);
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_default_role_permission(p_role text, p_permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_role='owner' THEN true
    WHEN p_role='admin' THEN p_permission = ANY(ARRAY[
      'users.delete','business.view','storefront.view','storefront.update','users.view','users.create_limited','users.update_role',
      'products.view','products.create','products.update','products.disable','products.stock_adjust','orders.view','orders.create',
      'orders.update','orders.cancel','orders.return','customers.view','customers.create','customers.update','reports.view',
      'categories.manage','inventory.view','register.manage','locations.manage','transfers.manage','credit.manage'
    ]::text[])
    WHEN p_role='manager' THEN p_permission = ANY(ARRAY[
      'users.view','users.create_limited','users.update_role','users.delete','customers.view','customers.create','customers.update',
      'business.view','storefront.view','products.view','products.create','products.update','products.disable','products.stock_adjust',
      'orders.view','orders.create','orders.update','orders.cancel','orders.return','reports.view','categories.manage','inventory.view',
      'register.manage','transfers.manage','credit.manage'
    ]::text[])
    WHEN p_role='cashier' THEN p_permission = ANY(ARRAY[
      'business.view','pos.access','products.view','orders.view','orders.create','orders.update','customers.view','customers.create',
      'customers.update','register.manage'
    ]::text[])
    WHEN p_role='staff' THEN p_permission = ANY(ARRAY[
      'business.view','products.view','orders.view','customers.view','inventory.view'
    ]::text[])
    ELSE false
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_receive_all_online_orders(p_business uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.tenh_user_permission_allowed(p_business,auth.uid(),'orders.view') and coalesce((select receive_all_branches from public.online_order_preferences where business_id=p_business and user_id=auth.uid()),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_subscription_is_expired_now(p_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (
      select
        b.subscription_status = 'expired'
        or (
          case
            when b.subscription_status = 'trialing'
              then coalesce(b.trial_expires_at, b.subscription_expires_at)
            else b.subscription_expires_at
          end
        ) is not null
        and (
          case
            when b.subscription_status = 'trialing'
              then coalesce(b.trial_expires_at, b.subscription_expires_at)
            else b.subscription_expires_at
          end
        ) <= now()
      from public.businesses b
      where b.id = p_business_id
    ),
    true
  );
$function$

relations.name: branch_products
relations.view_definition:
SELECT d.id,
    d.owner_id,
    d.category_id,
    d.name,
    d.sku,
    d.description,
    d.image_url,
    d.cost_price,
    d.selling_price,
    s.quantity AS stock_quantity,
    d.low_stock_quantity,
    d.is_active,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at,
    d.size,
    d.color,
    d.business_id,
    d.product_type,
    d.is_online,
    d.online_sort_order,
    d.variant_group_id,
    d.barcode,
    d.style_name,
    d.brand_name,
    d.low_stock_threshold,
    d.variant_image_url,
    d.bundle_stock_mode,
    d.is_pos,
    d.image_urls
   FROM (branch_product_details d
     JOIN product_location_stock s ON (((s.product_id = d.id) AND (s.business_id = d.business_id) AND (s.location_id = d.location_id))))
  WHERE ((NOT d.branch_archived) AND tenh_branch_setting_visible(d.business_id, d.location_id));
